name: Eiyo Clinic
description: Eiyo Clinic is a calm, typography-first WordPress theme designed for adult nutrition and dietetics practices. Inspired by editorial Japanese web design, it pairs warm high-key documentary photography with structured consultation schedules and transparent fee lists. Built with clean block patterns and subtle scroll motion, it presents everyday nutrition care with quiet clarity.
